profile_text.body:
ELLIS, also known as the European Laboratory for Learning and Intelligent Systems, is a nonprofit organization headquartered in Europe. Its website describes it as a pan-European AI network of excellence that unites top AI researchers through Programs, Sites, and a PhD program to advance excellence in machine learning. ELLIS states that it aims to secure lasting international leadership of AI made in Europe by connecting top researchers and creating a multi-centric AI research laboratory.

ELLIS does not list commercial products. Its activities center on research coordination. ELLIS Programs focus on advancing AI through theoretical foundations, algorithms, and applications such as health and climate, and are led by ELLIS Fellows and Scholars. The network of sites across Europe serves as hubs for world-class AI research, composed of local AI research institutions and universities or newly-created Institutes. The ELLIS PhD & Postdoc Program pairs students with leading researchers across Europe in machine learning, AI and related fields, offering international exchanges and joint supervision. The ELLIS Doctoral Symposium 2026, organized by ELLIS Unit Lisbon, brought together more than 100 PhD students, postdocs, researchers, and AI experts.

The available data lists no products, litigation, or MCP servers for ELLIS. It is recorded as a nonprofit organization headquartered in Europe, with no SEC or patent facts present.
